column1: # What a living thing is heard saying when it is hit and when it dies. The
# client plays it for the player at the keyboard only: every other entity's
# hurt and death sound is already in a sound packet, because Entity.playSound
# hands null to ClientLevel.playSeededSound and that plays nothing, while the
# server's broadcast leaves out only the player whose own sound it is.
# Proved on the test server: a cow hurt and killed sends entity.cow.hurt and
# entity.cow.death at volume 0.4, a zombie the same at 1.0, and the player's
# own hurt and death send nothing at all.
